$comment: Advisories accepted with justification for the CI dependency gate (SEC-046). Each entry MUST have a reason and an owner-reviewed expiry. Anything NOT listed here, at high/critical severity, fails the build. Review on or before each expiry.

allow.reason: Advisory is a crash in the Prometheus exporter's own HTTP server. This app constructs PrometheusExporter with preventServerStart:true (server/observability/telemetry.ts), so that HTTP server is never started and the vulnerable code path is not reachable. Only patched by a breaking-major OTel upgrade.
allow.followUp: SEC-056 — upgrade OpenTelemetry to a patched line and drop this exception

allow.reason: DoS via an unhandled exception in JaegerPropagator on a malformed inbound header. This app does not use Jaeger propagation anywhere (no JaegerPropagator reference in the codebase), so the vulnerable path is unreachable. Same OpenTelemetry tree as GHSA-q7rr; only patched by a breaking-major OTel upgrade.
allow.followUp: SEC-056 — upgrade OpenTelemetry to a patched line and drop this exception

$resolved: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (brace-expansion) was allowlisted here on the premise that the only npm-offered fix was a breaking-major eslint-plugin-import upgrade. That stopped being true once 1.1.18, 2.1.4 and 5.0.9 shipped: all three are patch releases inside the majors already installed, so every consumer range admits them and `npm update brace-expansion` fixes all nine install paths with no override and no package.json change. Exception removed 2026-08-06 rather than left to expire.
